summary: Depth on NSE cash, the book first (audit RB-04): a MarketDepthService frame before any MarketFeedV3 frame gives the book and its totals and no quote field; after the quote, the next book carries it.

notes: DEPTH and FEED are the web test's frames.

deviations.reason: A depth frame keeps ltp and timestamp before the instrument's first quote, for every broker (1.0.6 decision: the SDK's Depth callback reads them); the 5paisa web adapter leaves ltp out of a MarketDepthService frame that comes before any MarketFeedV3 frame (audit RB-04). The other quote fields are left out on both.
deviations.ref: CLAUDE.md (a depth frame before its instrument's first tick); feed/bridge.rs depth_update; fivepaisa_adapter.py:_normalize_market_data mode 3
